title: Industrial Disputes Act, 1947 — Section 25FFA (Notice of intention to close)

content.overview: Section 25FFA requires an employer intending to close down an undertaking to give sixty days' notice to the appropriate Government, subject to the stated exceptions.
content.glance: Section 25FFA requires an employer intending to close down an undertaking to give sixty days' notice to the appropriate Government, subject to the stated exceptions.
content.study: An employer who intends to close down an undertaking shall serve at least sixty days' notice on the appropriate Government, stating reasons. Exceptions cover undertakings with fewer than fifty workmen, undertakings set up for a construction project, and closure on account of unavoidable circumstances beyond the employer's control.

sections.body: Section 25FFA requires an employer intending to close down an undertaking to give sixty days' notice to the appropriate Government, subject to the stated exceptions.
